title: Derivative of the interior Gaussian profile
statement: Let $a\in(0,1)$. The Gaussian profile that equals the standard Gaussian density at the lower Gaussian quantile on $(0,1)$ and is zero outside that interval is differentiable at $a$, with derivative equal to the negative of the lower Gaussian quantile of $a$.
replaced: Let $\Phi,\varphi$ be the standard Gaussian distribution function and density, and let $\overline I(p)=\varphi(\Phi^{-1}(p))$ for $0<p<1$, with $\overline I(p)=0$ elsewhere. For $a\in(0,1)$, $\overline I'(a)=-\Phi^{-1}(a)$.
